title: [Audit] 🔎 Elasticsearch Data Access
description: What data was read, by whom, through which transport action — including system indices.

config.description: All Elasticsearch audit events in range.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-elasticsearch" | STATS `Elasticsearch events` = COUNT(*)

config.description: Distinct indices named in audited requests.
Requests on the ES|QL execution path — someone running queries, including these dashboards.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "*esql*" | STATS `ES|QL requests` = COUNT(*)

config.description: Requests touching dot-prefixed system indices (.kibana*, .security*, .slo-*, .alerts-*). Privileged by nature.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices IS NOT NULL | MV_EXPAND attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices | WHERE attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE ".*" | STATS `System index access` = COUNT(*)

config.description: Authorization denials. Sustained non-zero values mean a misconfigured client or a probe.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.event.action == "access_denied" OR attributes.event.action == "anonymous_access_denied" | STATS `Access denied` = COUNT(*)

config.title: Data access over time by category
config.description: Elasticsearch audit volume over time by ECS category, noise gate applied.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-elasticsearch" | WHERE (attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IN ("cluster:monitor/main", "elastic.maintenance") OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/search*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/*point_in_time" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:data/read/open_reader_context")) AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("authentication_success","connection_granted"))) | MV_EXPAND attributes.event.category | STATS events = COUNT(*) BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), category = attributes.event.category

config.title: Who reads which index
config.description: Heatmap of the busiest identity/index pairs — index down the side, identity across the top, colour is request volume. Reading down a column shows one identity's data footprint; reading across a row shows who touches an index.

config.title: Most-accessed indices
config.description: Which indices see the most audited access, and how many distinct identities touch each.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices IS NOT NULL | EVAL actor = COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>"), actor_kind = CASE(attributes.user.email IS NOT NULL, "human", "service") | MV_EXPAND attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices | STATS events = COUNT(*), actors = COUNT_DISTINCT(actor) BY index = attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices | SORT events DESC | LIMIT 15

config.title: Transport actions
config.description: Elasticsearch transport actions with their request class, after the noise gate removes health pings, search-phase internals and connection and bulk-authentication events.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IS NOT NULL | WHERE (attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action IN ("cluster:monitor/main", "elastic.maintenance") OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/search*" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "indices:data/read/*point_in_time" OR attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action == "indices:data/read/open_reader_context")) AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("authentication_success","connection_granted"))) | STATS events = COUNT(*) BY action = attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action, request = attributes.elasticsearch.audit.request.name | SORT events DESC | LIMIT 15

config.title: ⚠️ System and hidden index access
config.description: Access to dot-prefixed system indices — Kibana internals, the security index, alerting and SLO data. Sorted by most recent, not by volume: sorting by volume buries a one-off read under Kibana’s own continuous polling. Expected from elastic/kibana; unexpected from anyone else.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices IS NOT NULL | EVAL actor = COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>"), actor_kind = CASE(attributes.user.email IS NOT NULL, "human", "service") | MV_EXPAND attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices | WHERE attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE ".*" | STATS events = COUNT(*), last_seen = MAX(@timestamp) BY actor, index = attributes.elasticsearch.audit.indices, action = attributes.elasticsearch.audit.action | SORT last_seen DESC | LIMIT 25

config.title: Request outcome
config.description: Outcome distribution for Elasticsearch audit events.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-elasticsearch" | STATS events = COUNT(*) BY outcome = attributes.event.outcome

config.title: System index access
config.description: Every request against a dot-prefixed index, newest first.
